resources.title: The Raid that Saved EVERYTHING - Rust
resources.creator: Welyn
resources.noteEs: Hora completa de planning + execution de un raid critical. Cubre scouting, cálculo de costos en explosivos, ruta de raid y exfil. Perfecto para entender el flow real de un raid grande de principio a fin.
resources.noteEn: Full hour of planning + execution of a critical raid. Covers scouting, explosive cost calculation, raid route, and exfil. Perfect to understand the real flow of a big raid from start to finish.

resources.title: Destroying the MOST OBNOXIOUS Group - Rust
resources.creator: Welyn
resources.noteEs: Estilo clásico Welyn: identificar al clan tóxico del server, armar plan eco-raid y desmantelar la operación. Storytelling con annotation maps y breakdown de cada decisión táctica.
resources.noteEn: Classic Welyn style: identify the server's toxic clan, build an eco-raid plan, and dismantle the operation. Storytelling with annotation maps and breakdown of each tactical decision.

resources.title: MASTERING the MOST BROKEN META in RUST
resources.creator: Blooprint
resources.noteEs: Breakdown del meta de raid y combat más roto del wipe — qué loadouts, qué builds y qué tactics dominan en este parche. 90 minutos editoriales sobre por qué algo funciona en lugar de solo mostrar que funciona.
resources.noteEn: Breakdown of the most broken raid and combat meta of the wipe — which loadouts, which builds, which tactics dominate this patch. 90 editorial minutes on why something works rather than just showing it works.

resources.title: i lived in a missile silo...
resources.creator: spoonkid
resources.noteEs: Spoonkid sobrevive un wipe entero en el missile silo monument, defendiendo posición de raid attempts repetidos. Útil para ver defensive thinking aplicado a una ubicación inusual y limitaciones.
resources.noteEn: Spoonkid survives an entire wipe in the missile silo monument, defending position from repeated raid attempts. Useful to see defensive thinking applied to an unusual location with constraints.

resources.title: All Rust BUNKERS That Still Work in 2025 - Complete Guide
resources.creator: STELIC
resources.noteEs: Lista cuáles bunkers siguen funcionando después del último wipe — Facepunch nerfea bunkers cada par de meses. 9 minutos de auditoría: cuáles morir, cuáles seguir usando, cuáles están en gray area.
resources.noteEn: Lists which bunkers still work after the last wipe — Facepunch nerfs bunkers every couple months. 9 minutes of audit: which to drop, which to keep using, which are in gray area.
